admin-clear-degraded.json.rule: the admin API clears a health reason with health ok only (Q12)

amber-swap-with-scope.json.rule: an amber-to-amber swap declares no scope (source-health-canary L79, ADR-0052 L33 (d); R-2)

credential-revoked-degraded.json.rule: credential_revoked is never degraded (ADR-0016 L27; F-11)

dormant-decay-with-provenance.json.rule: a rule-9 dormant comes from the sweep over stored statistics: no provenance (D-3)

fallback-without-target.json.rule: fallback is non-null exactly when health is fallback (R-2)

flag-off-degraded.json.rule: flag_off takes health blocked only (ADR-0021 L61; F-11)

flag-off-not-admin.json.rule: only the admin API sends flag_off and flag_on (ADR-0021 L61; F-11)

free-text-reason.json.rule: reason is one closed list (ADR-0013, ADR-0014)

ig-webhook-push-coverage.json.rule: a client-owned Instagram account is never push_covered (ADR-0049, ADR-0066)

keyword-platform-meta-other-platform.jso.rule: only Instagram hashtags carry keyword platform_meta (F-13)

keyword-platform-meta-wrong-key.json.rule: a keyword's Instagram platform_meta names its bound account only (F-13)

lease-lapsed-still-covered.json.rule: a lapsed lease turns coverage off (ADR-0013)

mention-only-two-subjects.json.rule: an individual's mention is keyed by author_ref alone (ADR-0033)

not-a-decision-producer.json.rule: no producer row lets keyword-matcher send an add (ADR-0012, ADR-0013)

owned-add-id-mismatch.json.rule: an owned property's add carries its pre-allocated id as the subject (ADR-0066; F-39)

owned-add-without-id.json.rule: an owned property's add carries its pre-allocated id as the subject (ADR-0066; F-39)

platform-meta-other-platform.json.rule: platform_meta keys belong to one platform and source type (ADR-0065 c), ADR-0041)

provenance-refused.json.rule: a decision a person enters carries requested_by, never provenance (ADR-0003 L26)

provenance-required.json.rule: the qualifier's decisions from profiles carry provenance (ADR-0003 L26)

queued-over-cap-reason.json.rule: over the cap is rule_hit 5 with reason null (qualifier §5.2)

review-on-add.json.rule: review goes from add: requested_by names the reviewer (ADR-0013, ADR-0067)

route-degraded-without-reason.json.rule: a route-level state other than ok names its reason

route-flag-off-blocked.json.rule: the canary's flag_off returns a route to degraded (ADR-0021 L61; F-40)

route-health-with-source.json.rule: a route-level health_change carries no source_id (ADR-0013)

route-ok-with-reason.json.rule: a route's return to ok carries no reason

route-unknown-vendor.json.rule: vendors are the registry's, by route (ADR-0051)

rule-hit-out-of-range.json.rule: rule_hit is one of the qualifier's ten rules

scope-without-fallback.json.rule: scope is null unless health is fallback (R-2)

source-health-fallback.json.rule: a source-level health_change never sets fallback (ADR-0016)

target-without-fallback.json.rule: fallback is non-null exactly when health is fallback (R-2)

tier-change-profile-without-provenance.j.rule: a tier_change under rule 6 or 10 applies a resolver profile and carries its provenance (ADR-0003 L26; D-3)

tier-change-rule-not-allowed.json.rule: the qualifier's tier_change comes from rules 6, 9 and 10 only (D-3)

tier-change-sweep-with-provenance.json.rule: a rule-9 tier_change comes from the sweep over stored statistics: no provenance (D-3)

top-level-source-column.json.rule: the source columns travel in the add block (ADR-0013)

two-subjects.json.rule: a decision carries exactly one subject (ADR-0013)

unknown-requester.json.rule: a requester that names a service is one the registry lists (Q18; F-09)

update-vendor-unlisted.json.rule: a vendor named without its route is one the registry lists (ADR-0051; note 11)
